epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase supported epidemiological entity types cataloged from 1 to 3
requirements: R1: The system must validate and store protocol-specific attributes such as procedural steps and author approvals.
R2: The system must validate and store epidemiological data-specific structures such as sample metrics and collection parameters.

slices.title: Patch existing materials entity for protocols and data
slices.jtbd: When implementing the data structures for this epic, I want to patch the existing generic material entity to handle protocols and raw data, so that distinct entity types can be stored without new schemas.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user wants to add a protocol, when they submit the details, then the system validates and stores protocol-specific attributes.
Given a user wants to upload epidemiological data, when they submit the data, then the system validates and stores data-specific structures.
Given the single work item constraint, when tests run, then QA for protocol and data validation passes directly in this slice.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase supported entity types from 1 to 3 with 0 new database tables

epics.title: Material Revision History
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions to ensure clinical compliance and procedural safety.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce untracked protocol edits from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The system must track previous versions and maintain a revision history when protocols or materials are updated.
R2: The system must return a list of historical revisions showing who changed what and when, including the content of any past version.

slices.title: Patch existing endpoints for material revision history
slices.jtbd: When implementing version tracking for this epic, I want to patch existing endpoints and data logic to capture and retrieve revisions, so that the frontend history mockups can be populated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing protocol is edited and saved, when the backend processes it, then a historical revision is created and stored.
Given a user requests the history of a protocol, when they view the detailed page, then the endpoint returns a list of historical revisions.
Given the single work item constraint, when tests run, then integration tests for revision tracking pass directly in this slice.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the historical revisions retrieved from 0 to 100% for the history UI

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container stack launch failure rate from 100% to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Local developer observability and runtime verification bottleneck
requirements: R1: The product must launch successfully and pass its runtime health check.

slices.title: Fix runtime launch and health check failure
slices.jtbd: When fixing the launch process for this epic, I want to patch the existing configuration to resolve the startup failure, so that the product runs healthily and produces real evidence.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the product is in a failed runtime state, when the start command is executed, then the launch sequence completes without errors.
Given the application has launched, when the health check is queried, then it returns a healthy status.
Given the single work item constraint, when the launch is verified, then QA tests pass directly in this slice.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
